result.summary: Found 1 major content issue where an untranslated localization key is displayed as a section heading.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the 'home_feed.popular_title' key is properly mapped in the localization files and rendered with the translated text (e.g., 'Popular near you').
